title: Bind Staging semantic snapshot cardinality to canonical policy

phases.objective: Make the Staging schema importer validate canonical semantic snapshot cardinality from the canonical role-manifest policy instead of a stale hard-coded table count.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 validates an exact-commit schema bundle whose canonical semantic snapshot table list is defined by staging-database-role-migration-manifest.json.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The importer accepts the exact policy-defined semantic table count, including execution_policies, while still failing closed when manifest cardinality diverges from the policy.
steps: Read the canonical semantic snapshot policy table list from the role migration manifest.
Require the generated semantic snapshot table order to match that policy exactly.
Derive expected cardinality from the policy list rather than a duplicated integer constant.
Require bundle manifest table_count and materialized table list count to equal the derived policy cardinality.
Keep this pull request free of database, provider, Production, Hostinger, and Cloudflare mutations.
assertions: No numeric semantic snapshot table-count constant remains in Clone-StagingDatabases.Legacy.ps1.
execution_policies remains part of the canonical semantic snapshot policy.
Portable package manifest SHA-256 is updated to the exact modified importer bytes.
